metaTitle: BMW N20 Petrol Timing Chain Repair & Replacement | BMW Garage
metaDescription: Specialist BMW N20 timing chain repair. Front-mounted chain replacement, VANOS verification, compression testing. Fixed-price quotes from our workshop.
lede: Precise timing chain replacement for BMW N20 engines, including chain, guides, tensioners, and VANOS verification.

blocks.html: BMW N20 timing chain replacement is a specialist procedure performed in our workshop. The service includes full strip-down access to the front-mounted timing chain, replacement of the chain, guides, and tensioners, and reassembly with precision timing tools. We use genuine or OEM-quality parts, BMW-spec locking tools, and digital torque equipment. After reassembly, we verify VANOS operation and perform compression and leak-down tests to confirm sealing integrity.

items.q: What is included in the N20 timing chain replacement?
items.a: The service includes replacement of the timing chain, guides, tensioners, gaskets, and seals, plus full timing setup with BMW-spec locking tools, VANOS verification, and compression/leak-down testing.

items.q: How long does an N20 timing chain repair take?
items.a: Typically 3-5 working days, depending on vehicle condition and any additional findings during inspection.

items.q: Do you use genuine BMW parts?
items.a: Yes, we use genuine BMW or OEM-quality parts for all timing chain repairs.
